$description: Single source of truth for the mariomos.com design system. This file is the input; app/tokens.css and public/tokens.json are generated from it by scripts/build-tokens.mjs. Nothing in the site hard-codes a value that lives here.

$a11y.$note: Contrast targets, as ratios. Tokens declared with `solve` are generated by blending the base toward a direction until they meet the target against the named background - so an accessible value is computed, not eyeballed, and it is re-checked on every build.

$axes.primitive: Raw values. Six colours, one spacing scale, one type scale. Never referenced directly by a component.
$axes.semantic: Role-based aliases that components reference. These are what flip between light and dark.
$axes.derived: Computed from primitives by the build script. No new hex values are invented by hand.

ink.role: Deep navy. Text and dark surfaces. Not a tinted black - it reads as drafting ink.

paper.role: Cool white ground. Deliberately not cream.

redline.role: Magenta. Annotations, measurement marks, active states. The signal colour.

measure.role: Cyan. Secondary annotation - dimensions, grid overlays.

$use.$note: What each role is for, which decides how it is contrast-checked. text = carries copy (4.5:1 against bg, and against every tinted surface its solve rule names - a label on a quiet tint is checked on that tint). fill = a filled surface carrying fixed-colour text. line = a control boundary (3:1). mark = a graphical object that must be distinguishable (3:1). surface = a background, checked only via the roles drawn on it. inverse = text whose background is a fill, checked with that fill.

space.$note: space-N is N x 4px. The scale is sparse on purpose - only these steps are legal.

type.$note: Minor third from 16px. Nine steps, no improvisation between them.

measure.$note: Body copy is capped at 68 characters. Left-aligned, never centred.

width.$note: Bricolage Grotesque wdth axis. Headlines compress as the viewport narrows.

grid.$note: Content occupies columns 3-10. Columns 1-2 are the annotation margin; 11-12 are trailing air.

radius.$note: Near-square. Nothing on this site is a soft rounded card.

motion.$note: One orchestrated moment on load, then motion only answers actions.
